resources.string: First, manually enable Mika accessibility. Mika will try to enable Developer options, USB and wireless debugging, and pair this phone. If the system limits automatic actions, Mika will ask you to complete the affected steps manually. Enter any screen lock password and confirm system prompts yourself.
Manually enable the Mika accessibility service in Settings. Setup will continue automatically once it is connected.
Opening the pairing window. Mika will read the code and pair automatically.
Complete the confirmation or identity check on the system screen. Setup will then continue automatically.
Automatic setup has paused. Return to Mika to finish the steps manually, or try again.

The system prevents Mika from reading this settings page, so automatic setup has paused. Return to Mika, complete the current step below manually, then tap “Start automatic setup”. Completed steps will be skipped.
Automatic setup stopped. You can continue manually or start again.
